title: Renderer, preload, main process, and child IPC

requirements.initial: IPC requests are pending when the local Alice child is retired.
requirements.action: Close/send on the channel or switch connections.
requirements.expected: Pending requests reject and cannot leak into the replacement child.

evidence.assertion: rejects a request when the child IPC channel closes during send
evidence.scope: Mock IPC channel and request registry.

evidence.assertion: cancels in-flight requests before the local Alice child is retired
evidence.scope: Mock child retirement; no sandboxed renderer.

requirements.gap: Real renderer/preload reconnection and request cancellation require native evidence.

requirements.initial: An unsigned built Electron app has an isolated Workspace.
requirements.action: Open a PTY through preload and invoke the CLI/tool socket.
requirements.expected: Session/environment and observable output cross the actual process boundary.

evidence.scope: Real preload/main/tool socket with deterministic local AI.
